statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
This level of diagnostic testing is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmia responsible for the patient's transient cerebral ischemic events
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
